name: Spindrift Spritz
levelText: cleric 2, druid 2, hunter 1, inquisitor 2, oracle 2, paladin 1, ranger 1, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, warpriest 2
description: You can cast this spell only as a response to a target attempting a saving throw against an effect that would cause the fatigued, shaken, sickened, or staggered conditions. The target can roll its saving throw twice and take the higher result.
